mapper.select: SELECT l.*, a.name_zh AS app_name, p.name AS project_name FROM app_project_links l LEFT JOIN ui_apps a ON a.id = l.app_id LEFT JOIN api_projects p ON p.code = l.project_code WHERE l.app_id = #{appId} AND l.project_code = #{projectCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_project_links (app_id, project_code, platform, relation, note) VALUES (#{appId}, #{projectCode}, #{platform}, #{relation}, #{note})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM app_project_links WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND project_code = #{projectCode}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS appId, a.name_zh AS appName FROM ui_apps a LEFT JOIN app_project_links l ON l.app_id = a.id WHERE l.app_id IS NULL ORDER BY a.sort_order ASC, a.id ASC
